evidence_boundary: Training and epoch selection used NO test data. The freeze was written and all hashes verified before any test NIfTI was opened.
These 270 cases have now been consumed 6 times by this project; this is an internal held-out number, not clean external validation.
This result must NOT be used to select a next arm or tune hyperparameters. Further development returns to the 972/108 clean validation.
No threshold, TTA, morphology, connected-component or postprocessing search was run.

The main bottleneck identified in BOTTLENECK_DIAGNOSIS_20260806.json -- a generalization gap, with the architecture fitting 48 unaugmented cases to 0.885 -- is NOT addressed by this arm and remains open.
